leadText:
Florando (Japanese: ラフォールタウン Lafall Town) is an -exclusive town in Johto that appeared in Flower Power. It is located in between New Bark Town and Cherrygrove City.

Every year, there is the Pokémon Exhibition, a gigantic outdoor Pokémon entertainment festival where Pokémon Trainers and come from around the world to put on shows and perform. While they passed through Florando, , , and met Bailey, one of the performers in the Exhibition. They helped one of her overcome its lack of confidence in its -like performance.
